description: This file implements the FlateDecode filter in the PDFsharp library, providing methods for encoding and decoding data streams using the zlib/deflate compression algorithm. It manages compression levels, constructs appropriate headers, and integrates with the SharpZipLib library to handle compression tasks.

classes.name: FlateDecode
classes.description: Implements the PDF FlateDecode filter by wrapping SharpZipLib's deflate compression and decompression functionalities.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes data using the default compression mode.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes data using the specified compression mode.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data compressed with the Flate (deflate) algorithm, optionally processing decode parameters.
